reason: The rule states that no part of the body may protrude from a moving vehicle except to give a hand signal.
The rule specifies that a vehicle left in the same place for more than 24 hours outside an urban area is deemed abandoned.
The rule states that lighting requirements do not apply to a vehicle parked off the roadway, in a demarcated parking place, or within 12 metres of a lit street lamp.
The rule states that reversing a vehicle is permitted only if it can be done safely.
The rule specifies the color requirements for light motor vehicle direction indicators to the front and rear.
The rule states that a driver must obey road traffic signs and rules unless a traffic officer instructs otherwise.
The rule prohibits holding a cellular or other communication device with one or both hands or any other part of the body while driving.
The rule outlines compulsory stops when directed by a sign or officer, signalled by a person leading livestock, or when animals are crossing the road.
The rule prohibits crossing or entering a public road unless it is clear of moving traffic or can be done safely.
The rule states that when another vehicle wants to pass, the driver must keep left and not accelerate until it has passed.
The rule permits driving on the shoulder when being overtaken on a single-lane road, if safe and with sufficient visibility.
The rule specifies conditions for driving on the shoulder, including between sunrise and sunset, when being overtaken, safely, and with 150 metres visibility.
